## Core Specializations & Treatments
- HydraFacial & Medi-Facials: 4-in-1 vortex cleansing, painless blackhead extraction, and hyaluronic acid peptide infusion with zero downtime.
- Diode Laser Hair Removal: FDA-approved triple-wavelength diode laser with -4°C sapphire cooling for painless, permanent hair reduction on Indian skin.
- Acne & Acne Scar Revision: Fractional laser resurfacing, DermaPen microneedling with PRP, subcision, and salicylic/mandelic chemical peels.
- Melasma & Pigmentation Correction: Q-Switched Nd:YAG laser toning, tranexamic acid infusions, and medical depigmenting regimens.
- Anti-Aging, Botox & Dermal Fillers: Subtle, natural-looking wrinkle softening, volume restoration (cheeks, under-eyes, lips), and jawline contouring.
- Hair Loss & PRP/GFC Regrowth: Autologous Platelet-Rich Plasma and Growth Factor Concentrate therapies for male and female pattern hair thinning.
